title: Episode 3 (lines 922–1102)
focus: good news that is not good

teacherSummary.text: A messenger from Corinth brings news that King Polybus has died, and that Corinth wants Oedipus as king. Oedipus and Jocasta rejoice that the oracle seems false, but Oedipus still fears his mother, Merope. To calm him, the messenger reveals that Oedipus was not Polybus' son: he himself received the infant on Mount Cithaeron from a herdsman of Laius. Jocasta begs Oedipus to stop searching and leaves. Oedipus thinks she is ashamed of his low birth and calls himself the child of Fortune.
